listing.name: Brandon's Sci-fi Faction Flag Pack 1.3 - SERIES 2 Released
listing.summary: This mod adds a bunch of flags from various sci-fi factions.
listing.aiSummary: Adds faction flags inspired by various science fiction franchises.

description: Includes flags for factions from series like Star Wars, Star Trek, Halo, and Fallout. The latest update adds a second series of flags and updates the Brotherhood of Nod flag.

changelog.1.3: Mod version 1.3 was just released, which features SERIES 2 of the flags and a patch to the Brotherhood of Nod flag from SERIES 1 to more closely match what is depicted in game.
